race.comment: I'M LUCKY TWO (9) is racing well and is close to a win, the latest effort a solid third at Toowoomba over 1015m after being prominent from the outset. Looks well placed in this line-up so expect another big run. COPPER STAR (6) is going well with four minor placings from six starts this campaign. Turned in another good effort last time out when second over 1200m at Sunshine Coast after he was prominent throughout. Racing consistently and is sure to prove tough to beat. THUNDEROUS (4) gets 2kg off from the low draw and rarely puts in a poor one. Top-three candidate. LITTLE VAIN (2) is a last-start winner who shouldn't be slept on.
